An '''electromagnetic tube''' was a structure used in speeder train [[Hovertrain/Legends|mass-transit]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
Speeder trains like the 6-B traveled on routes through these tubes throughout the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]].<ref name="LL">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>
